rootCause.summary: The shared workspace store never received the structured DAT-27 extraction fields for this historical PDF, so the intake row remained a metadata-only Telegram document and no bookingProposal was generated.
details: The Telegram webhook payload persisted for the target document only contains message id, file id, file name, and MIME type.
The booking creation path in showcase/telegram-intake.js returns null when grossAmountEur or netAmountEur is missing.
The later DAT-27/DAT-29 evidence lives in deliverable artifacts, not in telegram_documents or buchungen.
The workspace booking table currently mirrors April/May 2026 fixture and Telegram demo bookings; it does not contain the historical 2024 external DATEV ledger.

cannotSafelyRepresentCurrentExternalPost: The account catalog has SKR03 BANK account 1200 and TRADE_PAYABLES 1600, but no CASH/Kasse purpose key for SKR03 account 1000.
The generic Telegram expense proposal credits TRADE_PAYABLES, which would mis-state this cash-paid receipt as an open payable.
buchungen has no explicit external DATEV booking number, external booked status, cash balance, or evidence-link fields for mirroring an already booked historical cashbook line.
dataModelConstraints.dedupeConstraint: Filename is not unique; any future import or link must key on documentId, submissionId, or telegramFileId.

decision.reason: The available evidence proves the external DATEV/cashbook booking, but the shared workspace ledger is a local operational store and does not yet model historical external cash postings accurately. Inserting a row with the current proposal path would create an inaccurate open-payable booking and could duplicate an already verbucht external record.
decision.futureImplementationGate: Only import or link this class of record after the store supports a cash/Kasse account purpose, external booking reference/status fields, and a post-extraction upsert/link path that is idempotent by documentId/submissionId/telegramFileId.

verification.result: No matching buchungen row exists; the target telegram_documents row exists but has null structured amounts/date and null linked_booking_id; external artifacts consistently show a booked 2024-11-22 cash posting.
